slides.headline: When a Glassdoor review names someone on your team
It stops being a company problem.
slides.body: It's personal for the person named, and it follows them.

slides.headline: It affects retention.
slides.body: Good managers leave over reviews that make them searchable for the wrong reasons.

slides.headline: Don't reply by naming anyone back.
slides.body: Or explaining what happened between them.

slides.headline: Talk to the person named first.
slides.body: Then send the review to us.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
